amr_database_evidence.note: 8 resistance genes detected: 7 OXA-type beta-lactamases + tet(O)

ResFinder.run_cmd: python -m resfinder -ifa data/contigs.fa -o actual/resfinder -j actual/resfinder/resfinder.json -s 'Campylobacter jejuni' -acq

AMRFinderPlus.run_cmd: mkdir -p actual/amrfinderplus && amrfinder --nucleotide data/contigs.fa --organism Campylobacter --output actual/amrfinderplus/amrfinder.tsv --plus

CARD_RGI.run_cmd: mkdir -p actual/card_rgi && rgi main --input_sequence data/contigs.fa --output_file actual/card_rgi/rgi --input_type contig --clean

abricate.run_cmd: mkdir -p actual/abricate && abricate --db resfinder data/contigs.fa > actual/abricate/abricate_resfinder.tsv && abricate --db card data/contigs.fa > actual/abricate/abricate_card.tsv

validation_instructions.resfinder: Expect 8 resistance genes: blaOXA-193, blaOXA-61, blaOXA-489, blaOXA-453, blaOXA-452, blaOXA-451, blaOXA-450, tet(O). Resistant phenotypes: ampicillin, amoxicillin, tetracycline (and derivatives). PASS if all 8 genes detected and ampicillin + tetracycline flagged resistant. PARTIAL if subset detected (e.g., only blaOXA-61 and tet(O)). FAIL if no genes found.
validation_instructions.amrfinderplus: Expect hits for beta-lactam resistance (OXA family) and tetracycline resistance (tet(O)). Exact gene naming may differ from ResFinder. PASS if both drug classes represented. PARTIAL if only one class detected.
validation_instructions.card_rgi: Expect Perfect or Strict hits for OXA-type beta-lactamases and tet(O). PASS if both drug classes represented with >= 95% identity. PARTIAL if sub-threshold or incomplete detection.
validation_instructions.abricate: Expect hits in resfinder DB for OXA genes and tet(O) at default thresholds (min-id 80, min-cov 80). PASS if both beta-lactam and tetracycline classes hit. FAIL if no hits.

notes: UCLA_1626 Campylobacter jejuni clinical isolate with beta-lactam (multiple OXA variants) and tetracycline (tet(O)) resistance. Good positive control for sensitivity testing. OXA multiplicity tests whether tools report all variants or collapse to a representative.
